clue.text: Providers of ring used for a marriage ceremony

definitions.text: Providers of ring used for a marriage ceremony

parts.words: Providers of ring used for a marriage ceremony
parts.note: the ring here is not the band on a finger but the peal rung out from a church tower when a couple marry

explanation.surface: It seems to describe the jeweller who supplies the wedding ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' looks like the gold band, but it is the sound that bells make, so the providers are the bells pealing at the wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Church bells rung to celebrate a marriage are known by this name, and they literally provide a ring.

clue.text: Wife's beginning with warm cereal

indicators.note: the beginning of the word Wife is its first letter, so only that letter is taken

parts.note: to warm something is to heat it

explanation.surface: A wife starts the day with a bowl of hot cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: This grain is a cereal crop, ground for flour and used in breakfast cereals.

clue.text: Unshakeable belief Fido's rug is moving initially

parts.note: Fido is the stock name for a pet dog
a small rug is a mat

indicators.note: initially asks for the first letter of the word moving

explanation.surface: Someone insists, against all evidence, that the dog's rug is shifting about.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogmatism is the stubborn assertion of opinions as certain truth, an unshakeable conviction.

clue.text: Prison rebel is terribly reckless

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly done or mangled, so the letters of the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebellious inmate is behaving very recklessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone reckless acts without care for consequences, which is what lacking a sense of duty means.

clue.text: Resent Gloucester unleaded garage being all empty

indicators.note: each word is emptied of its inside, leaving only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A driver in Gloucester resents finding every unleaded pump at the garage dry.
explanation.walkthrough: Gloucester is an English cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear a grudge against someone is to resent them, so the verb is a synonym.

clue.text: Phone system fans fight

parts.note: a telephone exchange connects calls in a phone network
a fan blows air, so fans means blows

explanation.surface: Supporters come to blows over a phone network.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fans' reads as supporters, which suits 'fight', but it is the verb: a fan blows.
explanation.definitionFit: To trade punches with someone is to fight them; the phrase is an idiom for brawling.

clue.text: Untruth some believe

indicators.note: some of the word believe means a part of it is taken from inside

explanation.surface: A cynical remark that some people believe a falsehood.
explanation.definitionFit: A falsehood told on purpose is an untruth, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Lose first two points on way in for sleepy state

indicators.note: to lose letters is to drop them from the word they belong to

parts.note: an entrance is a way in
E and N, east and north, are compass points, and they open the longer word

explanation.surface: A tired traveller loses their bearings at a doorway and drifts off.
explanation.definitionFit: A dazed, half-conscious condition like hypnosis is a dreamlike sleepy state.

clue.text: Showing enthusiasm, the Queen embraces maturity

indicators.note: embraces means holds within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
age means maturity, the state of being older

explanation.surface: The monarch keenly welcomes growing old.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and impatient to do something means displaying enthusiasm.

clue.text: Male relation, oddly airy and vague

parts.note: a parent's brother is a male relation

indicators.note: oddly picks the odd-numbered letters of airy, the first and third

explanation.surface: A relative who is a bit airy-fairy and vague.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vague is not clear or definite, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Cut short sports side's meal

indicators.note: a word cut short loses its last letter

parts.note: a sports side is a team; the apostrophe s joins it to meal

explanation.surface: A sports team's meal is curtailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is a light afternoon or evening meal in Britain.

clue.text: Engage a large chap as railway controller

parts.note: to engage a player is to sign them
L is the size abbreviation for large
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: Hiring a big fellow to run the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: This worker operates the signals on a railway line, controlling train movements.

clue.text: Large computer suffering RAM famine?

indicators.note: suffering suggests being knocked out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A big computer starved of memory chips.
explanation.definitionFit: A powerful central computer serving many users is a large computer of this type.

clue.text: Creature heads for river: has its nose out

indicators.note: the heads of the words are their first letters

explanation.surface: An animal makes for the river with its nose poking out of the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heads for' reads as 'goes towards', but asks for the first letters of the next five words.
explanation.definitionFit: This horned African mammal is an animal, so a creature.

clue.text: Salad vegetable is hard unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things going awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that a salad vegetable is tough to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: This peppery red root is commonly sliced raw into salads.

clue.text: Good and ready to complain

parts.note: ripe fruit is ready to eat

explanation.surface: Someone is all set to grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To grumble or moan about something is to complain; a slang synonym.

clue.text: Radiance of holy man amid temptation

indicators.note: amid means in the middle of, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a lure is a temptation
ST is the abbreviation for saint, a holy man

explanation.surface: A saint glows with virtue while surrounded by temptation.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft glow or sheen is radiance, a synonym.

clue.text: Mad quips rubbished British failure?

indicators.note: rubbished means dismissed as worthless and wrecked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Crazy jokes dismissed as a British flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A firework that fizzles out gives its name to an anticlimax or failure, a British idiom.

clue.text: Affected dresser's fine work

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A vain man's elegant handiwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A dandy, vain about his clothes and manners, is an affected dresser.

clue.text: Smooth out newspapers and magazines

definitions.meaning: to smooth out clothes is to iron them flat
the printed news media taken together

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to iron flat and the news media collectively.

clue.text: Mint, perhaps, in hard sweet stuff

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: set means hardened, as jelly sets
mint is an example of a herb, signalled by perhaps

explanation.surface: Mint flavouring in a hard candy.
explanation.definitionFit: This fizzy powder is a sweet treat, often sold as a confection.

clue.text: English travel showing self-importance

parts.note: to go is to travel

explanation.surface: English tourists display a sense of superiority.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflated sense of one's own worth is called this, meaning self-importance.

clue.text: Round fee to make a formal speech

parts.note: O is round in shape
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: A speaker paid a fixed sum to give an address.
explanation.definitionFit: To declaim at length in a pompous style is to make a formal speech.

clue.text: Vagrancy has pressure for male despair

indicators.note: pressure for male means the letter for pressure replaces the letter for male

parts.note: vagrancy is having no fixed abode
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Life on the streets brings pressure that drives a man to despair.
explanation.definitionFit: Despair is a total absence of expectation that things will improve.
